market_pulse.note: About $64,764 at 12:35 PM ET Sunday, down 1.71% over 24 hours (CoinDesk), after briefly dipping to about $62,199 overnight (CoinGecko data, via CryptoTicker).
About $1,816, down 1.4% over 24 hours, with a market value near $222 billion (CoinGecko), after trading as low as about $1,718 overnight (CryptoTicker).
About $2.19 trillion, down 1.3% over 24 hours, with $111.4 billion in 24-hour trading volume (CoinMarketCap).
About 59.4% of total crypto market value, with ether at about 10.1% (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Partial rebound after overnight lows
themes.summary: Bitcoin recovered to around $64,800 by midday Sunday from an overnight low near $62,200, trimming its 24-hour loss to 1.71% (CoinDesk; CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Sixth straight weekly loss in view
themes.summary: Bitcoin is on track for a sixth consecutive weekly decline; last Sunday's close was $74,740, and the price is about 49% below its Oct. 6, 2025 record of $126,080 (cryptonews.net).

themes.title: Stablecoin supply shrinks
themes.summary: Combined supply of USDT, USDC and DAI fell a record $11.5 billion over 30 days, per Coinbase Institutional, while U.S. ether ETFs saw $398.9 million of outflows from Nov. 9 to 13 (CryptoTicker).

themes.title: Sentiment stuck in extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index read 10 on Sunday, down from 32 on Tuesday (cryptonews.net); CoinMarketCap's own gauge stood at 12 out of 100 (CoinMarketCap).

themes.title: Rates and Fed stability warning weigh
themes.summary: CME FedWatch showed an 88.5% probability of a quarter-point Fed hike in December (CryptoTicker); the Fed's Nov. 13 financial stability report said asset valuation pressures remained elevated, and the 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.15% (cryptonews.net).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Bitcoin was down 1.71% and ether down 1.4% over 24 hours as of midday Sunday (CoinDesk; CoinGecko).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Solana near $71.13, XRP near $0.957, BNB near $590 and Dogecoin near $0.0585 (CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: DeFi and memecoins
categories.note: Among the top 100 coins, Pudgy Penguins fell 16.8%, Pump.fun 15.2%, Uniswap 14.4% and ether.fi 13.6% over 24 hours, the biggest decliners (CoinMarketCap).

categories.name: Derivatives and ETFs
categories.note: Roughly $1 billion of positions were liquidated market-wide over 24 hours, including $382 million in bitcoin, mostly longs (bitcoin.com, via CryptoTicker); U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs had about $1.91 billion of net outflows over seven sessions through Nov. 13 (cryptonews.net).

watch_list.why: Coinbase Institutional flags $62,000 as a technical reference, $60,000 is the next round number, and the July 1 close of $58,566 is the 12-month low (CryptoTicker; cryptonews.net).

watch_list.topic: ETF flows when U.S. markets reopen
watch_list.why: Spot bitcoin ETFs have seen seven straight sessions of net redemptions; ether funds ended a six-day outflow streak with a $2.3 million inflow on Nov. 13 (cryptonews.net).

watch_list.topic: Nvidia earnings, Fed minutes and the Anthropic IPO
watch_list.why: Nvidia reports Tuesday, minutes from the Oct. 27-28 Fed meeting are due Wednesday, and Anthropic is expected to debut on Nasdaq Thursday (Stockopedia).

movers.name: Pieverse (PIEVERSE)
movers.note: About $1.81; top 24-hour gainer among the top 100 coins (CoinMarketCap).

movers.name: Pudgy Penguins (PENGU)
movers.note: About $0.00513; the weakest of the top 100 coins over 24 hours (CoinMarketCap).
